title: MessageCatalog
description: The localization contract of the guidance layer. `actions` maps every GuidanceInstruction id to its actor and its allowed message keys; `messages` holds the vi (primary) and en (future) text for every key. Engines emit ids and keys only — never text (AGENTS.md, architecture.md ADR-009). Cross-file validation lives in specs/validation/validate_specs.py.

actions.description: Key = GuidanceInstruction id (guidance-instruction.schema.json). The key set must equal that schema's id enum.

messageKeys.description: Every message key this action may be rendered as. An action with more than one key is contextual (e.g. left/right or gentle/urgent variants).

messages.description: Key = message key. Vietnamese is the primary MVP language; English is authored now so that localization survives (owner decision 2026-10-03).

params.description: Names of the numeric params the message interpolates (must match GuidanceInstruction.params keys supplied by the engine).

explanations.description: Key = rule id (specs/rules/mvp-rules.json); value = the message key of the explanation shown when the user asks why an instruction appeared. The validator requires one entry per rule and that every value exists in `messages`.
